releaseNotes: Five selectable remote themes: Premium Dark, Light Clean, Glass Modern, Minimal Focus and Living Room Style. Open Settings → Appearance → Remote Theme for previews, instant switching, saved selection and Restore default. Native responsive controls keep the existing TV command handlers. Playback, Info and Exit remain in More; numeric and colour controls are in More → Advanced TV Keys. Netflix, YouTube and Prime Video shortcuts continue using the TV-reported installed apps.
